seed: The transform values popover, at Next defaults with no flag changed. A title is typed over a recording and picked. Turning it with the knob draws nothing over the picture: the values never come up by themselves. Info on the tool bar opens them within a frame, with X, Y, W, H and Rotation; swinging the title with the flat arc while they are open adds Tilt X, Tilt Y, Depth and Pivot, and the swing is photographed mid drag with Tilt Y outlined. A whole sum typed into X lands, an angle typed in lands, +10 on the angle steps it on from there. Reset puts the turn and tilt back and leaves the place alone. Escape closes it and leaves the title picked; an arrow key does not bring it back; Info opens it again and picking another tool closes it within a frame.

steps.note: the title picked: its box, handles and turn knob, nothing over them, and Info at the tool bar's right end

THE FIRST TEST: the knob turned the title and nothing came up over it; a click on Info opened the values over the tool bar: X, Y, W, H, Rotation and Reset. Nothing about 3D, because nothing about the title is in 3D

the flat arc swung the title 40 degrees on Y with the values open: Tilt X, Tilt Y, Depth and Pivot joined them, and Tilt Y reads 40. The picture held mid swing shows Tilt Y outlined while the hand moved it
THE SECOND TEST: 1920/2 typed into X put the title's left edge at 960; 12 typed into Rotation turned it to 12, and +10 then took it on to 22. The values are still open
THE THIRD TEST: Reset put the turn and the tilt back to nought in one step, so the 3D values left the list; X still reads 960, because Reset leaves the place alone
Escape closed the values and nothing else: the title is still picked
THE FOURTH TEST: an arrow key nudged the title one point without opening anything; Info opened the values on X 961; picking the Text tool is another operation, and they closed with it
